cards.title: Diagrams from data
cards.text: Every picture in the docs, every flow on the site and every card an agent draws, from data by one renderer.

cards.title: A diagram is JSON
cards.text: Read through records. A typo, an unknown kind or a link to nothing is refused with its reason.

cards.title: A layout per kind
cards.text: Flows, cards, sequences, classes and tickets. Each proves every word fits.

cards.title: One SVG, two looks
cards.text: The site's palette and its light twin, nothing loaded from outside.

cards.title: The icons
cards.text: 30 of Tabler's outline icons, copied in with their MIT licence.

cards.title: The docs' tool
cards.text: louis-agent.doc-diagrams writes each JSON's SVG beside it. A test holds them.

cards.title: The chat's cards
cards.text: An agent's ShowCard call read into a ticket and drawn inline, its styles kept to itself.
